basis: The routing criterion is the lowest feedback share in the dashboard. The chart's vertical axis ('Value') is inconsistent with the percentage labels (e.g., Service Design is at ~49 on the axis but labeled 12%), so the axis is not a reliable encoding of the share. The percentage inscriptions are the only consistent source of share values. The printed shares are: Service Quality 52%, Service Cost 51%, Service Design 12%, Support Access 17%, Service Delivery 42%, and Other 41%. The smallest value is 12% for Service Design.
option_label: Route Service Design to low-feedback coverage follow-up
